noTeam.subtitle: You're not in any team yet.
noTeam.title: Join a team or create your own startup
noTeam.body: The dashboard and idea validation work in the context of a specific startup. Until you're in a team, you use the Social layer — that's where you meet people and find projects you can join.
blocker.goalNoNote: The goal doesn't say yet what's blocking the work.
blocker.pausedWhy: The next stage won't open until you resume work in the team settings.
blocker.archivedWhy: The data stays available to read. The Founder can restore it in the team settings.
blocker.preparingWhy: The stage is already in the program, but its questions haven't been loaded yet.
blocker.waitingManagers: You're waiting for the Founder or an Admin
blocker.waitingManagersWhy: As a Member you can read everything, but stage answers are filled in by people with a higher role.
next.applications: {count, plural, one {Review an application to the team} other {Review # applications to the team}}
next.applicationsWhy: Until you reply, these people are waiting.
next.contacts: {count, plural, one {Someone wants to get in touch with you} other {# people want to get in touch with you}}
next.contactsWhy: The conversation opens once you accept the contact.
next.findPeopleWhy: Adding an open role makes your team show up among those recruiting.
next.finishStageWhy: All required sub-points are filled in.
next.goalAwaitingProof: There's a result, the proof is missing.
next.invites: {count, plural, one {Reply to a team invitation} other {Reply to # team invitations}}
next.invitesWhy: Someone is waiting for your decision.
next.readStage: Review what the team has already decided
next.readStageWhy: You have full insight into the stage answers.
next.waitingMeta: You · someone is waiting for a reply
panel.activityEmpty: Nothing has happened yet. The first goal or task will appear here.
panel.activityLocked: Team activity will appear together with goals and tasks — after Preparation is completed.
panel.deadlinesLocked: Goals and their deadlines open after Preparation is completed.
panel.noDeadlines: The team has no open deadlines right now.
panel.wantToJoin: {count, plural, one {# person wants to join — the decision is yours} other {# people want to join — the decision is yours}}
programDone.title: The program is complete
programDone.body: Results, goals and materials stay available to read. Further guidance after the MVP Stage is a separate conversation about working together. Completing the program doesn't mean the company is already a proven success.
stage.canReturn: You can come back here and change your answers
stat.alone: Building alone? Invite someone with a link
stat.members: {count, plural, one {person in the team} other {people in the team}}
stat.programStart: stages behind you — just getting started
where.behind: {count, plural, one {one stage behind you} other {# stages behind you}}
